Runs fully offline as a revision-based model pack: Streaming Paraformer zh/en INT8 writes replaceable live text, CT-Transformer restores semantic Chinese/English punctuation, and SenseVoice Small INT8 supplies the quality final. Models are optional, revision-pinned, hash-verified, isolated from the IME process, and stored in private no-backup storage. Audio never leaves the device.
The OpenTypeless offline model is not installed.

This three-model offline pack requires a supported 64-bit ARM/x86 device that Android does not classify as low-RAM. ASR and punctuation run in separately reclaimable workers but can transiently use several hundred MiB together. Use Android on-device recognition or BYOK instead.

Speech Core v2 measures :local_stream, :local_quality, and :local_punctuation and never reports an unobserved process as zero. A non-zero start value is a cached isolated worker; use peak minus start for this take's increment.
